brief: Prioritise clearance work over other remedial activity where a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, as restricted airflow removes the cooling margin the unit relies on during sustained high ambient conditions [SOP-011]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified [MG-021].
